release_notes: Biometric sign-in now works. Face sign-in was checking an in-memory template that only exists after a login, so it always failed - the template is now stored on the device. Fingerprint sign-in enrols automatically after your first password login (one confirmation), and all biometric settings start enabled so they work out of the box until you turn them off. Face check-in always stays available so a punch is never blocked.
